# Synthetic fixture feeds

**These are invented test feeds, not real timetables.** They are generated by `generate.py`. Stop coordinates sit on real streets near Halkapınar so OTP can route walking transfers over a real OSM clip; every name is prefixed `Fixture`.

| Feed | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `fx_metro` | weekday/weekend service, trips past midnight (24:20), a calendar_dates exception |
| `fx_tram` | daily service with shapes; a transfer partner for `fx_metro` at Halkapınar |
| `fx_bus_expired` | calendar ended 2024-12-31, so it must be excluded from routing |
| `broken_*` | structural failures: missing column, orphan stop_time, non-monotonic times |
